purpose: One arithmetic and provenance pass over the numbers the owner will act on. Each item states what was compared and the outcome.

items.check: Ranking order is the descending order of the published weighted scores
items.method: Recomputed sum(score_components[k] * weight[k]) for every ranked row and compared with the published sequence.
items.outcome: pass — strictly descending except the Rapid Flow / Ayoob tie at 3.150, whose published order matches the stored sequence
items.finding: Rapid Flow and Ayoob & Peery both score 3.150, so positions 3 and 4 are a tie broken by editorial order. The published page does not say that they are tied.

items.method: Sum of the five C-criterion weights.

items.check: Owner-estimate arithmetic quoted in the estimates analysis
items.method: Recomputed the spread and the ratio from the three owner-reported amounts.
items.outcome: pass — the published '$479' and 'about 4.55 times' both reproduce

items.check: DBI plumbing and mechanical fee amounts
items.method: Read the July 2026 fee schedule PDF and compared Category 1P and Category 11P/M.
items.result: Category 1P $290; Category 11P/M $320; hourly $519 regular and $555 off-hour; re-inspection $259 per half hour
items.outcome: pass — the published $290 and $320 match the schedule, and the page labels them fees, not prices

items.check: No owner amount is presented as verified
items.method: Read amount_verified for all three estimate rows and searched the rendered pages for an unlabelled amount.
items.result: amount_verified is null for E-01, E-02 and E-03; the verifier asserts this on every build

items.check: No numeric review rating or review count is published
items.method: Read rating and review_count for all 18 review observations and searched the pages for star-rating patterns.
items.result: all null; the verifier rejects numeric star ratings in the pages

items.check: Every ranked row carries a phone number that matches its official licence record
items.method: Compared the published phone with the business phone on each CSLB licence-detail page retrieved on 2026-11-10.
items.result: 10 of 10 ranked rows and the restoration partner match their records

items.check: The suspended licence is not offered as a hire option
items.method: Read the licence-detail page for #1027286 and the rendered ranking page.
items.result: status is Contractors Bond Suspension; the licence appears only in the excluded list and in F-09

items.check: No provider has been contacted, booked or paid
items.method: Searched the repository for any contact, booking or payment record.
items.result: none found; availability, acceptance and price remain unconfirmed for every provider

items.check: Yelp review evidence could be retrieved this session
items.method: Requested the Yelp search page for bathtub overflow trip lever repair in San Francisco.
items.outcome: blocked — ratings, counts and review text stay blank rather than being supplied from memory. This reproduces the limitation recorded by earlier sessions.

licence number, phone, expiry, status and city for the unresolved Portola identity
